## Load Functions
### 1) Parse Genbank files
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper: extract a top-level GenBank field
# ============================================================

extract_gb_field <- function(lines, field) {
  
  x <- lines[grepl(paste0("^", field), lines)]
  
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  trimws(sub(paste0("^", field, "\\s*"), "", x[1]))
}


# ============================================================
# Helper: extract full nucleotide sequence from ORIGIN
# ============================================================

extract_gb_sequence <- function(lines) {
  
  origin_start <- which(grepl("^ORIGIN", lines))
  record_end   <- which(grepl("^//", lines))
  
  if (length(origin_start) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  end_pos <- record_end[record_end > origin_start[1]][1]
  
  seq_lines <- lines[
    (origin_start[1] + 1):(end_pos - 1)
  ]
  
  sequence <- paste0(seq_lines, collapse = "")
  
  # Remove position numbers, spaces, etc.
  sequence <- gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", sequence)
  sequence <- toupper(sequence)
  
  sequence
}


# ============================================================
# Parse qualifiers belonging to one GenBank feature
# ============================================================

parse_gb_qualifiers <- function(lines) {
  
  if (length(lines) == 0) {
    return(list())
  }
  
  x <- trimws(lines)
  
  result <- list()
  current_key <- NULL
  current_value <- NULL
  
  flush_value <- function(key, value, result) {
    
    if (is.null(key)) {
      return(result)
    }
    
    value <- paste(value, collapse = " ")
    value <- trimws(value)
    
    # Remove surrounding quotation marks
    value <- sub('^"', "", value)
    value <- sub('"$', "", value)
    
    # Translation should not contain whitespace
    if (key == "translation") {
      value <- gsub("\\s+", "", value)
    }
    
    # Handle repeated qualifiers
    if (!is.null(result[[key]])) {
      result[[key]] <- paste(result[[key]], value, sep = "; ")
    } else {
      result[[key]] <- value
    }
    
    result
  }
  
  
  for (line in x) {
    
    if (grepl("^/", line)) {
      
      # Save previous qualifier
      result <- flush_value(
        current_key,
        current_value,
        result
      )
      
      item <- substring(line, 2)
      
      if (grepl("=", item, fixed = TRUE)) {
        
        eq_pos <- regexpr("=", item, fixed = TRUE)[1]
        
        current_key <- substring(item, 1, eq_pos - 1)
        current_value <- substring(item, eq_pos + 1)
        
      } else {
        
        current_key <- item
        current_value <- "TRUE"
      }
      
    } else if (!is.null(current_key)) {
      
      # Continuation of a multi-line qualifier
      current_value <- c(current_value, line)
    }
  }
  
  # Save final qualifier
  result <- flush_value(
    current_key,
    current_value,
    result
  )
  
  result
}


# ============================================================
# Extract all GenBank features
# ============================================================

extract_gb_features <- function(lines) {
  
  features_start <- which(grepl("^FEATURES", lines))
  origin_start   <- which(grepl("^ORIGIN", lines))
  
  if (length(features_start) == 0 ||
      length(origin_start) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  feature_lines <- lines[
    (features_start[1] + 1):(origin_start[1] - 1)
  ]
  
  
  # New features start with exactly five spaces followed
  # by a non-space feature name
  feature_starts <- which(
    grepl("^     \\S", feature_lines)
  )
  
  if (length(feature_starts) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  feature_ends <- c(
    feature_starts[-1] - 1,
    length(feature_lines)
  )
  
  
  feature_list <- map2(
    feature_starts,
    feature_ends,
    function(start_i, end_i) {
      
      block <- feature_lines[start_i:end_i]
      
      header <- block[1]
      
      feature_type <- trimws(
        substr(header, 6, 20)
      )
      
      location <- trimws(
        substr(header, 21, nchar(header))
      )
      
      
      # Find first qualifier
      if (length(block) > 1) {
        
        rest <- block[-1]
        
        qualifier_start <- which(
          grepl("^\\s+/", rest)
        )
        
      } else {
        
        rest <- character(0)
        qualifier_start <- integer(0)
      }
      
      
      # Some complex locations may continue over several lines
      if (length(rest) > 0) {
        
        if (length(qualifier_start) > 0 &&
            qualifier_start[1] > 1) {
          
          location_continuation <-
            rest[1:(qualifier_start[1] - 1)]
          
          location <- paste0(
            location,
            paste0(trimws(location_continuation),
                   collapse = "")
          )
          
        } else if (length(qualifier_start) == 0) {
          
          location <- paste0(
            location,
            paste0(trimws(rest), collapse = "")
          )
        }
      }
      
      
      # Qualifiers
      if (length(qualifier_start) > 0) {
        
        qualifier_lines <-
          rest[qualifier_start[1]:length(rest)]
        
        qualifiers <- parse_gb_qualifiers(
          qualifier_lines
        )
        
      } else {
        
        qualifiers <- list()
      }
      
      
      tibble(
        feature_type = feature_type,
        location = location
      ) %>%
        bind_cols(
          as_tibble(qualifiers)
        )
    }
  )
  
  bind_rows(feature_list) %>%
    mutate(
      feature_index = row_number(),
      .before = 1
    )
}


# ============================================================
# Parse one GenBank file
# ============================================================

read_evo_genbank <- function(file) {
  
  lines <- readLines(
    file,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Basic fields
  # ----------------------------
  
  locus <- extract_gb_field(lines, "LOCUS")
  definition <- extract_gb_field(lines, "DEFINITION")
  accession <- extract_gb_field(lines, "ACCESSION")
  version <- extract_gb_field(lines, "VERSION")
  source <- extract_gb_field(lines, "SOURCE")
  
  
  organism_line <- lines[
    grepl("^  ORGANISM", lines)
  ]
  
  organism <- if (length(organism_line) > 0) {
    trimws(sub("^  ORGANISM\\s*", "", organism_line[1]))
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Sequence
  # ----------------------------
  
  genome_sequence <- extract_gb_sequence(lines)
  
  genome_length <- nchar(genome_sequence)
  
  
  # ----------------------------
  # LOCUS properties
  # ----------------------------
  
  topology <- case_when(
    grepl("\\bcircular\\b", locus, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "circular",
    grepl("\\blinear\\b", locus, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "linear",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  
  
  molecule_type <- case_when(
    grepl("\\bDNA\\b", locus) ~ "DNA",
    grepl("\\bRNA\\b", locus) ~ "RNA",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Features
  # ----------------------------
  
  features <- extract_gb_features(lines)
  
  
  # Get source feature qualifiers
  source_feature <- features %>%
    filter(feature_type == "source") %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
  
  
  get_source_value <- function(column) {
    
    if (nrow(source_feature) == 0 ||
        !column %in% names(source_feature)) {
      
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    
    as.character(source_feature[[column]][1])
  }
  
  
  isolate <- get_source_value("isolate")
  record_isolate <- get_source_value("isolate")
  
  host <- get_source_value("host")
  country <- get_source_value("country")
  collection_date <- get_source_value("collection_date")
  mol_type <- get_source_value("mol_type")
  
  
  # ----------------------------
  # QC quantities
  # ----------------------------
  
  n_CDS <- sum(
    features$feature_type == "CDS",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  n_features <- nrow(features)
  
  
  gc_content <- (
    stringr::str_count(genome_sequence, "G") +
    stringr::str_count(genome_sequence, "C")
  ) / genome_length
  
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Metadata table
  # ----------------------------
  
  metadata <- tibble(
    
    file_name = basename(file),
    
    locus = locus,
    
    accession = accession,
    accession_version = version,
    
    definition = definition,
    
    source = source,
    organism = organism,
    isolate = record_isolate,
    host = host,
    country = country,
    collection_date = collection_date,
    
    molecule_type = molecule_type,
    mol_type_annotation = mol_type,
    topology = topology,
    
    genome_length = genome_length,
    GC_content = gc_content,
    
    n_features = n_features,
    n_CDS = n_CDS,
    
    file_md5 = as.character(
      tools::md5sum(file)
    )
  )
  
  
  # Add accession to feature table
  features <- features %>%
    mutate(
      accession = accession,
      accession_version = version,
      #isolate = isolate,
      isolate_record = record_isolate,
      .before = 1
    )
  
  
  genome <- tibble(
    accession = accession,
    accession_version = version,
    isolate = isolate,
    genome_length = genome_length,
    genome_sequence = genome_sequence
  )
  
  
  list(
    metadata = metadata,
    features = features,
    genome = genome
  )
}



# Infer WT phix174 CDS from the WT protein sequences
# ============================================================
# Helper: clean sequence
# ============================================================

clean_sequence <- function(x) {
  toupper(gsub("\\s+", "", x))
}


# ============================================================
# Helper: extract nucleotide positions from circular genome
# ============================================================

extract_nt_positions <- function(genome, positions) {

  genome <- clean_sequence(genome)

  paste0(
    substr(
      rep(genome, length(positions)),
      positions,
      positions
    ),
    collapse = ""
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Infer one CDS from exact WT genome + WT protein sequence
# ============================================================

# Protein-sequence-guided reconstruction of known CDS coordinates on the circular reference genome.
infer_reference_CDS_one <- function(
    genome,
    protein,
    protein_sequence
) {

  genome <- clean_sequence(genome)
  protein_sequence <- clean_sequence(protein_sequence)

  genome_length <- nchar(genome)

  # Double genome so genes crossing the circular origin
  # can be found as one continuous sequence
  genome_double <- paste0(
    genome,
    genome
  )

  candidate_list <- list()


  for (frame in 0:2) {

    available_length <-
      nchar(genome_double) - frame

    usable_length <-
      available_length -
      (available_length %% 3)

    frame_nt <- substr(
      genome_double,
      frame + 1,
      frame + usable_length
    )

    frame_aa <- as.character(
      Biostrings::translate(
        Biostrings::DNAString(frame_nt),
        if.fuzzy.codon = "X"
      )
    )


    hits <- gregexpr(
      protein_sequence,
      frame_aa,
      fixed = TRUE
    )[[1]]

    hits <- hits[hits > 0]


    if (length(hits) > 0) {

      for (aa_start in hits) {

        # CDSstart​=f+3(k−1)
        nt_start_linear <-
          frame + 1 +
          (aa_start - 1) * 3 

        # Ignore duplicate occurrence in second copy
        if (nt_start_linear > genome_length) {
          next
        }

        protein_length <-
          nchar(protein_sequence)

        coding_length <-
          protein_length * 3

        coding_end_linear <-
          nt_start_linear +
          coding_length - 1

        stop_start_linear <-
          coding_end_linear + 1

        stop_end_linear <-
          stop_start_linear + 2


        stop_codon <- substr(
          genome_double,
          stop_start_linear,
          stop_end_linear
        )

        stop_translation <- as.character(
          Biostrings::translate(
            Biostrings::DNAString(stop_codon)
          )
        )

        has_stop <-
          stop_translation == "*"


        # Coordinates of amino-acid coding region
        coding_positions <-
          ((seq(
            nt_start_linear,
            coding_end_linear
          ) - 1) %% genome_length) + 1


        # Stop codon positions
        if (has_stop) {

          stop_positions <-
            ((seq(
              stop_start_linear,
              stop_end_linear
            ) - 1) %% genome_length) + 1

        } else {

          stop_positions <- integer(0)
        }


        coding_sequence <-
          extract_nt_positions(
            genome,
            coding_positions
          )


        reconstructed_protein <-
          as.character(
            Biostrings::translate(
              Biostrings::DNAString(
                coding_sequence
              )
            )
          )


        translation_match <-
          identical(
            reconstructed_protein,
            protein_sequence
          )


        # GenBank-like location text
        cds_end_linear <-
          if (has_stop) {
            stop_end_linear
          } else {
            coding_end_linear
          }

        cds_end_ref <-
          ((cds_end_linear - 1) %%
             genome_length) + 1


        if (cds_end_linear <= genome_length) {

          location <- paste0(
            nt_start_linear,
            "..",
            cds_end_ref
          )

          crosses_origin <- FALSE

        } else {

          location <- paste0(
            "join(",
            nt_start_linear,
            "..",
            genome_length,
            ",1..",
            cds_end_ref,
            ")"
          )

          crosses_origin <- TRUE
        }


        candidate_list[[length(candidate_list) + 1]] <-
          tibble::tibble(

            protein = protein,

            start = nt_start_linear,

            coding_end =
              ((coding_end_linear - 1) %%
                 genome_length) + 1,

            CDS_end = cds_end_ref,

            location = location,

            strand = "+",

            crosses_origin =
              crosses_origin,

            protein_length =
              protein_length,

            coding_nt_length =
              coding_length,

            stop_codon =
              ifelse(
                has_stop,
                stop_codon,
                NA_character_
              ),

            has_terminal_stop =
              has_stop,

            translation_matches_reference =
              translation_match,

            coding_positions =
              list(coding_positions),

            stop_positions =
              list(stop_positions)
          )
      }
    }
  }


  candidates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    candidate_list
  )


  if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Could not locate protein ",
        protein,
        " in WT genome."
      )
    )
  }


  # Exact protein should normally give one candidate
  candidates %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      translation_matches_reference
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
}


# ============================================================
# Extract sequence from GenBank location
#
# Supports:
#   100..300
#   join(5000..5386,1..100)
#   complement(...)
# ============================================================

extract_from_genbank_location <- function(
    genome,
    location
) {

  genome <- clean_sequence(genome)

  location <- gsub(
    "\\s+",
    "",
    location
  )

  # Remove uncertainty symbols
  location <- gsub(
    "[<>]",
    "",
    location
  )


  is_complement <-
    grepl(
      "^complement\\(",
      location
    )


  if (is_complement) {

    location <- sub(
      "^complement\\(",
      "",
      location
    )

    location <- sub(
      "\\)$",
      "",
      location
    )
  }


  location <- sub(
    "^join\\(",
    "",
    location
  )

  location <- sub(
    "^order\\(",
    "",
    location
  )

  location <- sub(
    "\\)$",
    "",
    location
  )


  segments <- strsplit(
    location,
    ","
  )[[1]]


  segment_sequences <- purrr::map_chr(
    segments,
    function(segment) {

      if (grepl("\\.\\.", segment)) {

        coords <- strsplit(
          segment,
          "\\.\\."
        )[[1]]

        start <- as.integer(
          coords[1]
        )

        end <- as.integer(
          coords[2]
        )

        substr(
          genome,
          start,
          end
        )

      } else {

        pos <- as.integer(
          segment
        )

        substr(
          genome,
          pos,
          pos
        )
      }
    }
  )


  seq <- paste0(
    segment_sequences,
    collapse = ""
  )


  if (is_complement) {

    seq <- as.character(
      Biostrings::reverseComplement(
        Biostrings::DNAString(seq)
      )
    )
  }


  seq
}


# ============================================================
# Translation helper
# ============================================================

translate_CDS_for_QC <- function(
    cds_sequence,
    codon_start = 1
) {

  cds_sequence <-
    clean_sequence(
      cds_sequence
    )

  codon_start <-
    suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(codon_start)
    )

  if (
    is.na(codon_start) ||
    codon_start < 1
  ) {
    codon_start <- 1L
  }


  cds_sequence <- substr(
    cds_sequence,
    codon_start,
    nchar(cds_sequence)
  )


  # Keep complete codons only
  usable_length <-
    nchar(cds_sequence) -
    (nchar(cds_sequence) %% 3)


  if (usable_length == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }


  cds_sequence <- substr(
    cds_sequence,
    1,
    usable_length
  )


  protein <- as.character(
    Biostrings::translate(
      Biostrings::DNAString(
        cds_sequence
      ),
      if.fuzzy.codon = "X"
    )
  )


  # GenBank /translation does not include terminal *
  protein <- sub(
    "\\*$",
    "",
    protein
  )


  protein
}






```


### 2) Plotting
```{r}
# Function to make heatmaps 
build_mutation_heatmap_data <- function(
    genome_metadata,
    mutation_data,
    rescue_changes = NULL,
    rescue_annotation = NULL
) {

  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Genome metadata
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  genomes <- genome_metadata %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      viability_state =
        dplyr::case_when(

          viability_group == "Nonviable" ~
            "Nonviable",

          acquired_mutations_during_rebooting ~
            "Viable after rescue",

          rebooting_viable ~
            "Viable",

          TRUE ~
            "Other"
        )
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Add rescue annotations when available
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  if (!is.null(rescue_annotation)) {

    genomes <- genomes %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        rescue_annotation %>%
          dplyr::select(
            original_design_id,
            pure_SNV_rescue,
            single_SNV_rescue,
            n_rebooting_SNV_changes,
            n_rebooting_indel_changes
          ),
        by = "original_design_id",
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      )

  } else {

    genomes <- genomes %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        pure_SNV_rescue = FALSE,
        single_SNV_rescue = FALSE,
        n_rebooting_SNV_changes = 0L,
        n_rebooting_indel_changes = 0L
      )
  }


  genomes <- genomes %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      pure_SNV_rescue =
        tidyr::replace_na(
          pure_SNV_rescue,
          FALSE
        ),

      single_SNV_rescue =
        tidyr::replace_na(
          single_SNV_rescue,
          FALSE
        ),

      # concise row labels
      heatmap_label =
        dplyr::case_when(

          single_SNV_rescue ~
            paste0(
              isolate,
              " | Viable after rescue | 1 SNV"
            ),

          viability_state ==
            "Viable after rescue" ~
            paste0(
              isolate,
              " | Viable after rescue"
            ),

          viability_state ==
            "Viable" ~
            paste0(
              isolate,
              " | Viable"
            ),

          TRUE ~
            paste0(
              isolate,
              " | Nonviable"
            )
        ),

      viability_state =
        factor(
          viability_state,
          levels = c(
            "Nonviable",
            "Viable after rescue",
            "Viable"
          )
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      viability_state,
      isolate
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Designed detrimental/lethal substitutions
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  designed_focus <- mutation_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      mutation_type == "substitution",
      DMS_effect_category %in%
        c(
          "Detrimental",
          "Lethal"
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      genome_position_numeric =
        as.integer(genome_position)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      original_design_id,
      mutation_id,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Rescue events belonging to genomes in this subset
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  if (!is.null(rescue_changes)) {

    rescue_subset <- rescue_changes %>%
      dplyr::semi_join(
        genomes %>%
          dplyr::select(
            original_design_id
          ),
        by = "original_design_id"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(

        plot_mutation_id =
          dplyr::case_when(

            rebooting_change ==
              "Reversion to WT" ~
              designed_mutation_id,

            rebooting_change %in%
              c(
                "New mutation",
                "Changed allele"
              ) ~
              recovered_mutation_id,

            TRUE ~
              NA_character_
          )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(plot_mutation_id)
      )

  } else {

    rescue_subset <- tibble::tibble(
      original_design_id = character(),
      isolate = character(),
      genome_position = integer(),
      rebooting_change = character(),
      plot_mutation_id = character()
    )
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation universe:
  # designed damaging mutations + rescue mutations
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  mutation_axis <- dplyr::bind_rows(

    designed_focus %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        mutation_id,
        genome_position_numeric
      ),

    rescue_subset %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        mutation_id =
          plot_mutation_id,

        genome_position_numeric =
          as.integer(
            genome_position
          )
      )
  ) %>%

    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(mutation_id),
      !is.na(genome_position_numeric)
    ) %>%

    dplyr::distinct(
      mutation_id,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    ) %>%

    dplyr::arrange(
      genome_position_numeric,
      mutation_id
    )


  mutation_order <-
    mutation_axis$mutation_id

  genome_order <-
    genomes$heatmap_label


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Build complete genome × mutation matrix
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  heatmap <- tidyr::crossing(

    original_design_id =
      genomes$original_design_id,

    mutation_id =
      mutation_order
  ) %>%

    dplyr::left_join(
      genomes %>%
        dplyr::select(
          original_design_id,
          isolate,
          heatmap_label,
          viability_state,
          dplyr::any_of(
            c(
              "has_indel",
              "n_indel_events",
              "single_SNV_rescue"
            )
          )
        ),
      by = "original_design_id",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::left_join(
      designed_focus %>%
        dplyr::select(
          original_design_id,
          mutation_id,
          DMS_effect_category
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(),
      by = c(
        "original_design_id",
        "mutation_id"
      ),
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::mutate(

      heatmap_category =
        dplyr::case_when(

          DMS_effect_category ==
            "Lethal" ~
            "Lethal",

          DMS_effect_category ==
            "Detrimental" ~
            "Detrimental",

          TRUE ~
            "Absent"
        ),

      mutation_id =
        factor(
          mutation_id,
          levels =
            mutation_order
        ),

      heatmap_label =
        factor(
          heatmap_label,
          levels =
            genome_order
        )
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare rescue overlay
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  rescue_overlay <- rescue_subset %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      genomes %>%
        dplyr::select(
          original_design_id,
          heatmap_label,
          single_SNV_rescue
        ),
      by = "original_design_id",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::mutate(

      plot_mutation_id =
        factor(
          plot_mutation_id,
          levels =
            mutation_order
        ),

      heatmap_label =
        factor(
          heatmap_label,
          levels =
            genome_order
        )
    )


  list(
    genomes = genomes,
    mutation_axis = mutation_axis,
    heatmap = heatmap,
    rescue_overlay = rescue_overlay
  )
}
```

Aligning phage genomes 
- Build functions and validata on single genomes. (Confirmed, working for genomic single-nucleotide variants calling)
```{r}
# load packages
#library(tidyverse)
#library(Biostrings)
#library(pwalign)


# ============================================================
# Convert aligned reference/query strings into mutation blocks
# ============================================================

call_mutations_from_alignment <- function(
    aligned_ref,
    aligned_query,
    level = c("nt", "aa"),
    protein = NULL
) {
  
  level <- match.arg(level)
  
  ref_chars <- strsplit(aligned_ref, "")[[1]]
  query_chars <- strsplit(aligned_query, "")[[1]]
  
  if (length(ref_chars) != length(query_chars)) {
    stop("Aligned reference and query must have the same length.")
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Track reference and query coordinates across alignment
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  ref_pos <- integer(length(ref_chars))
  query_pos <- integer(length(query_chars))
  
  r <- 0L
  q <- 0L
  
  for (i in seq_along(ref_chars)) {
    
    if (ref_chars[i] != "-") {
      r <- r + 1L
      ref_pos[i] <- r
    } else {
      ref_pos[i] <- r
    }
    
    if (query_chars[i] != "-") {
      q <- q + 1L
      query_pos[i] <- q
    } else {
      query_pos[i] <- q
    }
  }
  
  
  alignment_tbl <- tibble(
    alignment_position = seq_along(ref_chars),
    ref_char = ref_chars,
    query_char = query_chars,
    ref_position = ref_pos,
    query_position = query_pos
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      event = dplyr::case_when(
        
        ref_char == query_char ~ "match",
        
        ref_char != "-" &
          query_char != "-" ~ "substitution",
        
        ref_char != "-" &
          query_char == "-" ~ "deletion",
        
        ref_char == "-" &
          query_char != "-" ~ "insertion",
        
        TRUE ~ "unknown"
      )
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Substitutions
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  substitutions <- alignment_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(event == "substitution") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      mutation_type = "substitution",
      
      ref_start = ref_position,
      ref_end = ref_position,
      
      query_start = query_position,
      query_end = query_position,
      
      ref_allele = ref_char,
      alt_allele = query_char
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Group contiguous indels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  indel_tbl <- alignment_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(event %in% c("insertion", "deletion"))
  
  if (nrow(indel_tbl) > 0) {
    
    #indel_tbl <- indel_tbl %>%
      #dplyr::mutate(
        #new_block =
          #event != dplyr::lag(event, default = first(event)) |
          #alignment_position !=
            #dplyr::lag(
              #alignment_position,
              #default = first(alignment_position)
            #) + 1,
        
        #block_id = cumsum(new_block)
      #)
    
    indel_tbl <- indel_tbl %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          
          new_block =
            dplyr::row_number() == 1L |
            event != dplyr::lag(event) |
            alignment_position !=
              dplyr::lag(alignment_position) + 1L,
          
          block_id = cumsum(new_block)
        )
    
    indels <- indel_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(event, block_id) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        
        ref_start = min(ref_position),
        ref_end = max(ref_position),
        
        query_start = min(query_position),
        query_end = max(query_position),
        
        ref_allele = paste0(
          ref_char[ref_char != "-"],
          collapse = ""
        ),
        
        alt_allele = paste0(
          query_char[query_char != "-"],
          collapse = ""
        ),
        
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        mutation_type = event
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        mutation_type,
        ref_start,
        ref_end,
        query_start,
        query_end,
        ref_allele,
        alt_allele
      )
    
  } else {
    
    indels <- tibble(
      mutation_type = character(),
      ref_start = integer(),
      ref_end = integer(),
      query_start = integer(),
      query_end = integer(),
      ref_allele = character(),
      alt_allele = character()
    )
  }
  
  
  mutations <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    substitutions,
    indels
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      ref_start,
      query_start
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add mutation IDs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (level == "nt") {
    
    mutations <- mutations %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        
        mutation_id = dplyr::case_when(
          
          mutation_type == "substitution" ~
            paste0(
              ref_allele,
              ref_start,
              alt_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "deletion" &
            ref_start == ref_end ~
            paste0(
              ref_start,
              "del",
              ref_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "deletion" ~
            paste0(
              ref_start,
              "_",
              ref_end,
              "del",
              ref_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "insertion" ~
            paste0(
              ref_start,
              "_",
              ref_start + 1L,
              "ins",
              alt_allele
            )
        ),
        
        mutation_id_full = paste0(
          "nt_",
          mutation_id
        )
      )
    
  } else {
    
    if (is.null(protein)) {
      stop("protein must be supplied for amino-acid mutations.")
    }
    
    mutations <- mutations %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        
        mutation_id = dplyr::case_when(
          
          mutation_type == "substitution" ~
            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein,
              "_",
              ref_allele,
              ref_start,
              alt_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "deletion" &
            ref_start == ref_end ~
            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein,
              "_",
              ref_start,
              "del",
              ref_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "deletion" ~
            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein,
              "_",
              ref_start,
              "_",
              ref_end,
              "del",
              ref_allele
            ),
          
          mutation_type == "insertion" ~
            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein,
              "_",
              ref_start,
              "_",
              ref_start + 1L,
              "ins",
              alt_allele
            )
        )
      )
  }
  
  
  list(
    mutations = mutations,
    coordinate_map = alignment_tbl
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Align one Evo genome against WT and call nucleotide mutations
# ============================================================

align_and_call_nt_mutations <- function(
    reference_sequence,
    query_sequence,
    isolate,
    accession_version = NA_character_
) {
  
  reference_sequence <- toupper(
    gsub("\\s+", "", reference_sequence)
  )
  
  query_sequence <- toupper(
    gsub("\\s+", "", query_sequence)
  )
  
  
  ref <- Biostrings::DNAString(reference_sequence)
  query <- Biostrings::DNAString(query_sequence)
  
  
  nt_matrix <- pwalign::nucleotideSubstitutionMatrix(
    match = 2,
    mismatch = -3,
    baseOnly = TRUE
  )
  
  
  aln <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(
    pattern = query,
    subject = ref,
    type = "global",
    substitutionMatrix = nt_matrix,
    gapOpening = 5,
    gapExtension = 2
  )
  
  
  # subject = WT
  # pattern = Evo
  
  aligned_ref <- as.character(
    pwalign::alignedSubject(aln)
  )
  
  aligned_query <- as.character(
    pwalign::alignedPattern(aln)
  )
  
  
  calls <- call_mutations_from_alignment(
    aligned_ref = aligned_ref,
    aligned_query = aligned_query,
    level = "nt"
  )
  
  
  mutations <- calls$mutations %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      isolate = isolate,
      accession_version = accession_version,
      .before = 1
    )
  
  
  coordinate_map <- calls$coordinate_map %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      isolate = isolate,
      accession_version = accession_version,
      .before = 1
    )
  
  
  qc <- tibble(
    isolate = isolate,
    accession_version = accession_version,
    
    reference_length = nchar(reference_sequence),
    query_length = nchar(query_sequence),
    aligned_length = nchar(aligned_ref),
    
    alignment_score = as.numeric(
      BiocGenerics::score(aln)
    ),
    
    n_substitutions = sum(
      mutations$mutation_type == "substitution"
    ),
    
    n_insertions = sum(
      mutations$mutation_type == "insertion"
    ),
    
    n_deletions = sum(
      mutations$mutation_type == "deletion"
    ),
    
    inserted_nt = sum(
      nchar(
        mutations$alt_allele[
          mutations$mutation_type == "insertion"
        ]
      )
    ),
    
    deleted_nt = sum(
      nchar(
        mutations$ref_allele[
          mutations$mutation_type == "deletion"
        ]
      )
    )
  )
  
  
  list(
    alignment = aln,
    aligned_reference = aligned_ref,
    aligned_query = aligned_query,
    coordinate_map = coordinate_map,
    mutations = mutations,
    QC = qc
  )
}
```

Aligning phage proteins
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Align one Evo protein against WT and call AA mutations
# ============================================================
align_and_call_aa_mutations <- function(
    reference_sequence,
    query_sequence,
    protein,
    isolate,
    accession_version = NA_character_
) {
  
  reference_sequence <- toupper(
    gsub("\\s+", "", reference_sequence)
  )
  
  query_sequence <- toupper(
    gsub("\\s+", "", query_sequence)
  )
  
  
  ref <- Biostrings::AAString(
    reference_sequence
  )
  
  query <- Biostrings::AAString(
    query_sequence
  )
  
  
  aln <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(
    pattern = query,
    subject = ref,
    type = "global",
    substitutionMatrix = "BLOSUM62",
    gapOpening = 10,
    gapExtension = 1
  )
  
  
  aligned_ref <- as.character(
    pwalign::alignedSubject(aln)
  )
  
  aligned_query <- as.character(
    pwalign::alignedPattern(aln)
  )
  
  
  calls <- call_mutations_from_alignment(
    aligned_ref = aligned_ref,
    aligned_query = aligned_query,
    level = "aa",
    protein = protein
  )
  
  
  mutations <- calls$mutations %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      isolate = isolate,
      accession_version = accession_version,
      protein = protein,
      .before = 1
    )
  
  
  coordinate_map <- calls$coordinate_map %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      isolate = isolate,
      accession_version = accession_version,
      protein = protein,
      .before = 1
    )
  
  
  qc <- tibble(
    
    isolate = isolate,
    accession_version = accession_version,
    protein = protein,
    
    reference_length =
      nchar(reference_sequence),
    
    query_length =
      nchar(query_sequence),
    
    aligned_length =
      nchar(aligned_ref),
    
    alignment_score =
      as.numeric(
        BiocGenerics::score(aln)
      ),
    
    n_substitutions =
      sum(
        mutations$mutation_type ==
          "substitution"
      ),
    
    n_insertions =
      sum(
        mutations$mutation_type ==
          "insertion"
      ),
    
    n_deletions =
      sum(
        mutations$mutation_type ==
          "deletion"
      )
  )
  
  
  list(
    alignment = aln,
    aligned_reference = aligned_ref,
    aligned_query = aligned_query,
    coordinate_map = coordinate_map,
    mutations = mutations,
    QC = qc
  )
}
```

Codon changes from the reference WT-aligned genome
- Get synonymous mutations in Evo design.
- Report codon-level synonymous/missense consequences only for a CDS with no insertion or deletion inside that CDS.
- Same nucleotide mutations can appear in more than one protein's codon table due to overlapping ORFs.
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Build codon changes from one genome alignment
# ============================================================

annotate_codon_changes <- function(
    nt_alignment_result,
    reference
) {

  coordinate_map <-
    nt_alignment_result$coordinate_map

  nt_mutations <-
    nt_alignment_result$mutations

  ref_genome <-
    reference$genome

  CDS_table <-
    reference$CDS


  isolate_name <-
    nt_alignment_result$QC$isolate[1]

  accession <-
    nt_alignment_result$QC$
      accession_version[1]


  codon_results <- list()
  protein_QC_results <- list()


  for (i in seq_len(nrow(CDS_table))) {

    CDS_row <- CDS_table[i, ]

    protein_name <-
      CDS_row$protein

    coding_positions <-
      CDS_row$coding_positions[[1]]


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Identify insertions/deletions inside this CDS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # An insertion after the FINAL coding nucleotide is not
    # considered part of the coding region here.
    internal_insertion_anchors <-
      coding_positions[
        -length(coding_positions)
      ]


    coding_deletions <-
      coordinate_map %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        event == "deletion",
        ref_position %in%
          coding_positions
      )


    coding_insertions <-
      coordinate_map %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        event == "insertion",
        ref_position %in%
          internal_insertion_anchors
      )


    inserted_nt <-
      nrow(coding_insertions)

    deleted_nt <-
      nrow(coding_deletions)


    net_indel <-
      inserted_nt -
      deleted_nt


    has_coding_indel <-
      inserted_nt > 0 |
      deleted_nt > 0


    frameshift <-
      has_coding_indel &&
      (abs(net_indel) %% 3 != 0)


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Protein-level QC record
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    protein_QC_results[[protein_name]] <-
      tibble::tibble(

        isolate =
          isolate_name,

        accession_version =
          accession,

        protein =
          protein_name,

        has_coding_indel =
          has_coding_indel,

        inserted_nt =
          inserted_nt,

        deleted_nt =
          deleted_nt,

        net_indel_nt =
          net_indel,

        frame_preserved =
          !has_coding_indel |
          (abs(net_indel) %% 3 == 0),

        frameshift =
          frameshift
      )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # If CDS contains an indel, do not naively assign codons
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (has_coding_indel) {
      next
    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Recover query nucleotide corresponding to each WT nt
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reference_rows <-
      coordinate_map %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        ref_char != "-"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        ref_position,
        query_char
      )


    coding_map <-
      tibble::tibble(
        ref_position =
          coding_positions,

        coding_nt_index =
          seq_along(
            coding_positions
          )
      ) %>%

      dplyr::left_join(
        reference_rows,
        by = "ref_position"
      ) %>%

      dplyr::mutate(

        WT_nt =
          substr(
            rep(
              ref_genome,
              dplyr::n()
            ),
            ref_position,
            ref_position
          ),

        codon_index =
          ceiling(
            coding_nt_index / 3
          ),

        codon_position =
          ((coding_nt_index - 1) %% 3) + 1
      )

    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Reconstruct complete WT and Evo CDS sequences
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    WT_CDS_sequence <- paste0(
      coding_map$WT_nt,
      collapse = ""
    )
    
    Evo_CDS_sequence <- paste0(
      coding_map$query_char,
      collapse = ""
    )
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Use translation table 11
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    genetic_code_11 <-
      Biostrings::getGeneticCode("11")
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Known WT protein is authoritative
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    WT_protein_reference <-
      reference$proteins %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        protein == protein_name
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(sequence)
    
    if (
      length(WT_protein_reference) != 1
    ) {
      stop(
        "Could not uniquely identify WT protein ",
        protein_name
      )
    }
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Translate complete Evo CDS
    #
    # Important:
    # translating the complete CDS ensures that alternative
    # bacterial initiation codons are treated as initiation
    # codons only at the first CDS position, rather than at
    # every codon.
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    Evo_protein_from_genome <-
      as.character(
        Biostrings::translate(
          Biostrings::DNAString(
            Evo_CDS_sequence
          ),
          genetic.code =
            genetic_code_11,
          if.fuzzy.codon =
            "X"
        )
      )
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Convert proteins into AA vectors
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    WT_AA_vector <-
      strsplit(
        WT_protein_reference,
        "",
        fixed = TRUE
      )[[1]]
    
    Evo_AA_vector <-
      strsplit(
        Evo_protein_from_genome,
        "",
        fixed = TRUE
      )[[1]]
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # QC sequence lengths
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    n_codons <-
      max(
        coding_map$codon_index
      )
    
    if (
      length(WT_AA_vector) != n_codons ||
      length(Evo_AA_vector) != n_codons
    ) {
    
      stop(
        isolate_name,
        " / ",
        protein_name,
        ": CDS/protein length mismatch. ",
        "Expected ",
        n_codons,
        " aa; WT = ",
        length(WT_AA_vector),
        ", Evo = ",
        length(Evo_AA_vector)
      )
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Collapse into complete codons
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    codons <-
      coding_map %>%

      dplyr::group_by(
        codon_index
      ) %>%

      dplyr::summarise(

        genome_positions =
          paste(
            ref_position,
            collapse = ","
          ),

        WT_codon =
          paste0(
            WT_nt,
            collapse = ""
          ),

        Evo_codon =
          paste0(
            query_char,
            collapse = ""
          ),

        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%

      dplyr::mutate(

        #WT_AA =
          #purrr::map_chr(
            #WT_codon,
            #~ as.character(
              #Biostrings::translate(
                #Biostrings::DNAString(
                 # .x
                #)
              #)
            #)
          #),

        #Evo_AA =
          #purrr::map_chr(
            #Evo_codon,
            #~ as.character(
              #Biostrings::translate(
                #Biostrings::DNAString(
                  #.x
                #)
              #)
            #)
          #),

        #WT_AA = substr(
          #WT_protein_reference,
          #codon_index,
          #codon_index
        #),
    
        #Evo_AA = substr(
          #Evo_protein_from_genome,
          #codon_index,
          #codon_index
        #),
        
        WT_AA = WT_AA_vector[codon_index],

        Evo_AA = Evo_AA_vector[codon_index],
        
        n_nt_changes =
          purrr::map2_int(
            WT_codon,
            Evo_codon,
            ~ sum(
              strsplit(.x, "")[[1]] !=
                strsplit(.y, "")[[1]]
            )
          ),

        consequence =
          dplyr::case_when(

            WT_codon == Evo_codon ~
              "unchanged",

            WT_AA == Evo_AA ~
              "synonymous",

            WT_AA != "*" &
              Evo_AA == "*" ~
              "nonsense",

            WT_AA == "*" &
              Evo_AA != "*" ~
              "stop_loss",

            TRUE ~
              "missense"
          ),

        protein =
          protein_name,

        aa_position =
          codon_index,

        aa_mutation_id =
          dplyr::if_else(
            WT_AA != Evo_AA,

            paste0(
              "gp",
              protein_name,
              "_",
              WT_AA,
              aa_position,
              Evo_AA
            ),

            NA_character_
          )
      )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Add contributing nucleotide mutation IDs
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    codons <-
      codons %>%

      dplyr::rowwise() %>%

      dplyr::mutate(

        nt_mutation_ids = {

          positions <-
            as.integer(
              strsplit(
                genome_positions,
                ","
              )[[1]]
            )

          ids <-
            nt_mutations %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              mutation_type ==
                "substitution",
              ref_start %in%
                positions
            ) %>%
            dplyr::pull(
              mutation_id
            )

          if (length(ids) == 0) {
            NA_character_
          } else {
            paste(
              ids,
              collapse = ";"
            )
          }
        }
      ) %>%

      dplyr::ungroup() %>%

      dplyr::mutate(
        isolate =
          isolate_name,

        accession_version =
          accession,

        .before = 1
      )


    # Keep changed codons only
    codon_results[[protein_name]] <-
      codons %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        consequence !=
          "unchanged"
      )
  }


  list(

    codon_changes =
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        codon_results
      ),

    protein_QC =
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        protein_QC_results
      )
  )
}
```

### 3) Scale-up mutation calling 
To 16 viable evo-designed phages
- evo_phage_analysis
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper to get one WT protein sequence
# ============================================================

get_reference_protein <- function(
    reference,
    protein_name
) {
  
  reference$proteins %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      protein == protein_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      sequence
    )
}


# ============================================================
# Process all annotated proteins from one isolate
# ============================================================

process_isolate_proteins <- function(
    isolate_name,
    accession_version,
    evo_proteins,
    reference
) {
  
  isolate_proteins <- evo_proteins %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      isolate_record == isolate_name,
      accession_version == accession_version,
      !is.na(protein)
    )
  
  
  reference_names <- reference$proteins$protein
  
  
  protein_results <- purrr::map(
    reference_names,
    function(protein_name) {
      
      evo_row <- isolate_proteins %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          protein == protein_name
        )
      
      
      # Protein not annotated in this genome
      if (nrow(evo_row) == 0) {
        
        return(
          list(
            protein = protein_name,
            status = "not_annotated",
            alignment = NULL,
            mutations = tibble::tibble(),
            QC = tibble::tibble(
              isolate = isolate_name,
              accession_version = accession_version,
              protein = protein_name,
              status = "not_annotated"
            )
          )
        )
      }
      
      
      # If somehow duplicated, use first but flag it
      duplicated_annotation <- nrow(evo_row) > 1
      
      evo_row <- evo_row %>%
        dplyr::slice(1)
      
      
      wt_seq <- get_reference_protein(
        reference = reference,
        protein_name = protein_name
      )
      
      
      result <- tryCatch(
        
        align_and_call_aa_mutations(
          reference_sequence = wt_seq,
          query_sequence = evo_row$protein_sequence,
          protein = protein_name,
          isolate = isolate_name,
          accession_version = accession_version
        ),
        
        error = function(e) {
          e
        }
      )
      
      
      if (inherits(result, "error")) {
        
        return(
          list(
            protein = protein_name,
            status = "alignment_error",
            error = conditionMessage(result),
            alignment = NULL,
            mutations = tibble::tibble(),
            QC = tibble::tibble(
              isolate = isolate_name,
              accession_version = accession_version,
              protein = protein_name,
              status = "alignment_error",
              error = conditionMessage(result)
            )
          )
        )
      }
      
      
      result$QC <- result$QC %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          status = "aligned",
          duplicated_annotation = duplicated_annotation
        )
      
      
      list(
        protein = protein_name,
        status = "aligned",
        alignment = result$alignment,
        aligned_reference = result$aligned_reference,
        aligned_query = result$aligned_query,
        coordinate_map = result$coordinate_map,
        mutations = result$mutations,
        QC = result$QC
      )
    }
  )
  
  
  names(protein_results) <- reference_names
  
  
  protein_mutations <- purrr::map_dfr(
    protein_results,
    "mutations"
  )
  
  
  protein_QC <- purrr::map_dfr(
    protein_results,
    "QC"
  )
  
  
  list(
    results = protein_results,
    mutations = protein_mutations,
    QC = protein_QC
  )
}


# ============================================================
# One complete isolate processor
# ============================================================

process_one_evo_phage <- function(
    isolate_name,
    #accession_version,
    accession_id,
    evo_metadata,
    evo_genomes,
    evo_proteins,
    evo_translation_QC,
    reference
) {
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Metadata
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  metadata_row <- evo_metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      isolate == isolate_name,
      accession_version == accession_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Genome
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  genome_row <- evo_genomes %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      isolate == isolate_name,
      accession_version == accession_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
  
  
  nt_result <- align_and_call_nt_mutations(
    reference_sequence = reference$genome,
    query_sequence = genome_row$genome_sequence,
    isolate = isolate_name,
    accession_version = accession_id
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Codon / genome-derived protein consequences
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  codon_result <- annotate_codon_changes(
    nt_alignment_result = nt_result,
    reference = reference
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Direct protein alignment
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  protein_result <- process_isolate_proteins(
    isolate_name = isolate_name,
    accession_version = accession_id,
    evo_proteins = evo_proteins,
    reference = reference
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # GenBank CDS translation QC
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  translation_QC <- evo_translation_QC %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      isolate_record == isolate_name,
      accession_version == accession_id
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Summary counts
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  summary <- tibble::tibble(
    
    isolate = isolate_name,
    accession_version = accession_id,
    
    genome_length = genome_row$genome_length,
    
    n_nt_substitutions =
      sum(
        nt_result$mutations$mutation_type ==
          "substitution"
      ),
    
    n_nt_insertions =
      sum(
        nt_result$mutations$mutation_type ==
          "insertion"
      ),
    
    n_nt_deletions =
      sum(
        nt_result$mutations$mutation_type ==
          "deletion"
      ),
    
    inserted_nt =
      nt_result$QC$inserted_nt,
    
    deleted_nt =
      nt_result$QC$deleted_nt,
    
    n_aa_substitutions =
      sum(
        protein_result$mutations$mutation_type ==
          "substitution"
      ),
    
    n_aa_insertions =
      sum(
        protein_result$mutations$mutation_type ==
          "insertion"
      ),
    
    n_aa_deletions =
      sum(
        protein_result$mutations$mutation_type ==
          "deletion"
      ),
    
    n_synonymous_codons =
      sum(
        codon_result$codon_changes$consequence ==
          "synonymous"
      ),
    
    n_missense_codons =
      sum(
        codon_result$codon_changes$consequence ==
          "missense"
      ),
    
    n_nonsense_codons =
      sum(
        codon_result$codon_changes$consequence ==
          "nonsense"
      ),
    
    n_proteins_with_coding_indel =
      sum(
        codon_result$protein_QC$has_coding_indel
      ),
    
    all_GenBank_translations_match =
      all(
        translation_QC$translation_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Final isolate object
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  list(
    
    metadata = metadata_row,
    
    genome = list(
      sequence = genome_row$genome_sequence,
      alignment = nt_result$alignment,
      aligned_reference = nt_result$aligned_reference,
      aligned_query = nt_result$aligned_query,
      coordinate_map = nt_result$coordinate_map,
      mutations = nt_result$mutations,
      QC = nt_result$QC
    ),
    
    codons = list(
      changes = codon_result$codon_changes,
      protein_QC = codon_result$protein_QC
    ),
    
    proteins = list(
      results = protein_result$results,
      mutations = protein_result$mutations,
      QC = protein_result$QC
    ),
    
    GenBank_translation_QC =
      translation_QC,
    
    summary =
      summary
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Cross-check genome-derived vs direct AA substitutions for all proteins
# ============================================================

validate_aa_calls <- function(
    isolate_name,
    codon_changes,
    aa_mutations
) {
  
  genome_calls <- codon_changes %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      isolate == isolate_name,
      consequence %in%
        c(
          "missense",
          "nonsense",
          "stop_loss"
        ),
      !is.na(aa_mutation_id)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      protein,
      aa_mutation_id
    )
  
  
  direct_calls <- aa_mutations %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      isolate == isolate_name,
      mutation_type ==
        "substitution"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      protein,
      mutation_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      aa_mutation_id =
        mutation_id
    )
  
  
  comparison <- dplyr::full_join(
    genome_calls %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        genome_call = TRUE
      ),
    
    direct_calls %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        direct_call = TRUE
      ),
    
    by = c(
      "protein",
      "aa_mutation_id"
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      genome_call =
        tidyr::replace_na(
          genome_call,
          FALSE
        ),
      
      direct_call =
        tidyr::replace_na(
          direct_call,
          FALSE
        ),
      
      calls_match =
        genome_call ==
        direct_call,
      
      isolate =
        isolate_name,
      
      .before = 1
    )
  
  
  comparison
}

  dplyr::filter(
```

```{r}
      ),
    protein %in%
      c("B", "C")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    isolate_record,
    protein,
    location,
    protein_sequence
  )

# These two mismatches are due to intragenic indels
# 1) For Evo-Phi100 protein C, the genome-based WT-coordinate reconstruction detects gpC_S10N from AGC → AAC at genomic position 161. But GenBank annotates C as: Evo-Phi100 C: 250..393; So gpC_S10N occurs in a genomic region that corresponds to WT C, but that region is no longer part of the annotated C protein in Evo-Phi100. That is why the direct protein alignment cannot contain gpC_S10N.
# 2) For Evo-Phi316 protein B, Its B CDS begins at: join(5190..5387,1..51) rather than the WT-like 5075..5386,1..51. In Evo-Phi316, that ATG has effectively become the new annotated start of the shortened B protein, so the direct protein representation is an N-terminal deletion rather than an internal V39M substitution.

# All nine non-indel discrepancies are explained
# They fall into recognizable categories:

# 1) K in Evo-Phi114/R1/R2: K is not annotated as a protein in GenBank.
# 2) Evo-Phi100 C and Evo-Phi316 B: CDS boundaries have shifted/truncated substantially.
# 3) gpC_K85*: stop/truncation behavior, which direct protein alignment cannot represent in exactly the same way as a codon substitution.

# So the initial apparent 98.2% agreement actually understates how well the two pipelines agree. For ordinary intact CDSs with comparable annotations, they appear essentially concordant.



# This analysis tells us we should keep the two sources conceptually distinct:
# Genome-derived coding consequences
#     ↓
# "What would this nucleotide change do
# in the WT ΦX174 coordinate/ORF system?"

# Direct GenBank protein alignment
#     ↓
# "What protein sequence is actually annotated
# in the Evo-designed genome?"


# For protein-level Evo mutation analysis, we use the direct protein alignment as the primary source. Thus for Evo-Phi316 B we keep: gpB_2_39del... rather than an ordinary gpB_V39M substitution.
# For nucleotide-level analysis, we retain the genomic mutation G5189A, and the existing 1-nt DMS annotation can tell us what that same nucleotide mutation does in the WT ΦX174 background.


# The Evo-design sequence extraction/alignment/validation stage complete and ready to move on to the DMS merge.
```

```{r}
# For the nucleotide level, use the existing genome_mut_ID_nt as the join key
phix_nt_DMS_merge <-
  phix_all_dms_sub_libraries_normalized_unique_stat_1nt %>%
  dplyr::transmute(

    mutation_id = genome_mut_ID_nt,

    # mutation identity
    genome_position = genome_nt_mut_pos,
    WT_nt_DMS = genome_nt_mut_wt,
    mutant_nt_DMS = genome_nt_mut_sub,

    # fitness
    DMS_fitness = fitness_final,
    DMS_FDR = p_value_1nt_two_sample_ttest_syn_FDR,
    DMS_effect_size = effect_size_vs_1nt_syn,

    # effect classification
    DMS_effect_category = 
      mutation_category_FDR_1nt,
    
    DMS_effect_category_lethal = 
      mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1nt,
    
    #DMS_effect_category_cutoff =
      #mutation_category_FDR_cutoff_1nt_combined,
    
    DMS_mutation_direction =
      mutation_direction_1nt,
    
    #DMS_mutation_direction =
      #mutation_direction_lethal_1nt,

    # genomic context
    nt_noncoding = genome_nt_pos_noncoding,
    nt_coding = genome_nt_pos_coding,
    nt_overlap_orf = genome_nt_pos_overlap_orf,
    nucleotide_class = genome_nt_pos_nucleotide_class,
    genome_annotation = genome_nt_pos_annotation,

    # regulatory annotations
    RBS = genome_nt_pos_RBS,
    RBS_gene = genome_nt_pos_RBS_gene,

    promoter = genome_nt_pos_promoter,
    promoter_gene = genome_nt_pos_promoter_gene,

    terminator = genome_nt_pos_terminator,
    terminator_gene = genome_nt_pos_terminator_gene,

    ori = genome_nt_pos_ori,

    # coding consequences already annotated in your DMS table
    affected_genes = phix_aa_mut_genes,
    aa_mutation_IDs = phix_aa_mut_ID,
    aa_mutation_class = phix_aa_mut_class
  )
```

### 3) Merge Evo designs and DMS data
- evo_nt_analysis
- evo_aa_analysis
 - evo_aa_analysis_single_orf
```{r}
# The nucleotide master table
evo_nt_analysis <-
  evo_nt_mutations %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    mutation_level = "nt",

    is_substitution =
      mutation_type == "substitution",

    is_indel =
      mutation_type %in%
      c("insertion", "deletion")
  ) %>%

  dplyr::left_join(
    phix_nt_DMS_merge,
    by = "mutation_id"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    DMS_available =
      !is.na(DMS_fitness),

    DMS_status =
      dplyr::case_when(

        is_indel ~
          "Indel not assayed",

        DMS_available ~
          "DMS covered",

        TRUE ~
          "DMS not covered"
      )
  )


# Report nucleotide classification
evo_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    mutation_type == "substitution"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    nt_noncoding,
    nt_coding,
    nt_overlap_orf
  )

#   nt_noncoding nt_coding nt_overlap_orf

# 2 NA           Coding    Overlapping Coding
# 3 Noncoding    NA        NA                
# 4 NA           NA        NA                

names(

)

  "Noncoding",
  "Single coding",
  "Overlapping coding",
  "DMS not covered"
)

  dplyr::mutate(
    genomic_context = dplyr::case_when(
      nt_overlap_orf == "Overlapping Coding" ~ "Overlapping coding",
      nt_coding == "Coding" ~ "Single coding",
      nt_noncoding == "Noncoding" ~ "Noncoding",
      TRUE ~ "DMS not covered"
    ),
    genomic_context = factor(
      genomic_context,
      levels = genomic_context_levels
    )
  )
```

### 4) Counts and Proportions of mutations, overview
The count of detrimental and non-detrimental mutants in each of the 16 Evo-phage
- Subset the 16 Evo design phages provided with the lytic rank
```{r}
# Define the 16 phages
analysis_isolates <- intersect(
  unique(evo_lytic_ranking$isolate),
  unique(evo_nt_analysis$isolate)
)

length(analysis_isolates)
analysis_isolates
# [1] "Evo-Phi2483" "Evo-Phi69"   "Evo-Phi108"  "Evo-Phi111"  "Evo-Phi114"  "Evo-Phi46"   "Evo-Phi2498" "Evo-Phi5"    "Evo-Phi100"  "Evo-Phi2147" "Evo-Phi75"   "Evo-Phi36"   "Evo-Phi4"    "Evo-Phi3392" "Evo-Phi316"  "Evo-Phi63"  


# NT substitutions: detrimental vs non-detrimental per phage
nt_effect_counts_by_phage <- evo_nt_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    isolate %in% analysis_isolates,
    mutation_type == "substitution",
    DMS_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    isolate,
    mutation_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effect_group = dplyr::case_when(
      DMS_effect_category %in% c(
        #"Reduced replication",
        #"Strongly detrimental"
        
        "Detrimental",
        "Strongly detrimental"
      ) ~ "Detrimental",

      DMS_effect_category %in% c(
        #"Increased replication",
        #"No measurable effect"
        
        "Increased",
        "No effect"
      ) ~ "Non-detrimental",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(effect_group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(isolate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_nt_total = dplyr::n(),

    n_nt_detrimental = sum(
      effect_group == "Detrimental"
    ),

    n_nt_non_detrimental = sum(
      effect_group == "Non-detrimental"
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

nt_effect_counts_by_phage

# A reusable function to plot bar plots
plot_detrimental_bar <- function(
    data,
    isolate_col,
    detrimental_col,
    non_detrimental_col,
    title,
    y_label = "Mutation count",
    isolate_levels = NULL
) {

  isolate_col <- rlang::ensym(isolate_col)
  detrimental_col <- rlang::ensym(detrimental_col)
  non_detrimental_col <- rlang::ensym(non_detrimental_col)

  plot_df <- data %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      isolate = as.character(!!isolate_col),
      Detrimental = !!detrimental_col,
      `Non-detrimental` = !!non_detrimental_col
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c("Detrimental", "Non-detrimental"),
      names_to = "effect_group",
      values_to = "count"
    )

  if (!is.null(isolate_levels)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        isolate = factor(
          isolate,
          levels = isolate_levels
        )
      )
  }

  total_df <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(isolate) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_count = sum(count),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = isolate,
      y = count,
      fill = effect_group
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(
      width = 0.85,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = detrimental_group_colors,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = total_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = isolate,
        y = total_count,
        label = total_count
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = -0.3,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Evo-phage isolate",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      clip = "off"
    )
}



# Function to get the Min/Median/Max function
summarise_detrimental_range <- function(
    data,
    detrimental_col,
    non_detrimental_col
) {

  detrimental_col <- rlang::ensym(detrimental_col)
  non_detrimental_col <- rlang::ensym(non_detrimental_col)

  det_name <- rlang::as_name(detrimental_col)
  nondet_name <- rlang::as_name(non_detrimental_col)

  df <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(!!detrimental_col),
      !is.na(!!non_detrimental_col)
    )

  min_value <- min(
    df[[det_name]],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  median_value <- stats::median(
    df[[det_name]],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  max_value <- max(
    df[[det_name]],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  min_rows <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data[[det_name]] == min_value
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      statistic = "Minimum",
      detrimental_count = .data[[det_name]],
      isolate,
      non_detrimental_count = .data[[nondet_name]]
    )

  max_rows <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data[[det_name]] == max_value
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      statistic = "Maximum",
      detrimental_count = .data[[det_name]],
      isolate,
      non_detrimental_count = .data[[nondet_name]]
    )

  median_distance <- abs(
    df[[det_name]] - median_value
  )

  median_rows <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      abs(.data[[det_name]] - median_value) ==
        min(median_distance)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      statistic = "Median / closest to median",
      detrimental_count = .data[[det_name]],
      isolate,
      non_detrimental_count = .data[[nondet_name]]
    )

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    min_rows,
    median_rows,
    max_rows
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      median_detrimental_count = median_value
    )
}
```

Reusable data-preparation and plotting function
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Prepare stacked bar summary data
# ============================================================

prepare_stacked_percent_data <- function(
    data,
    class_var,
    category_var,
    facet_var = NULL
) {

  class_var <- rlang::ensym(class_var)
  category_var <- rlang::ensym(category_var)

  if (is.null(facet_var)) {

    summary_df <- data %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(!!class_var),
        !is.na(!!category_var)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::count(
        !!class_var,
        !!category_var,
        name = "count"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!class_var) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        total_count = sum(count),
        percent = 100 * count / total_count
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()

    total_df <- summary_df %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        !!class_var,
        total_count
      )

    return(
      list(
        summary_df = summary_df,
        total_df = total_df
      )
    )
  }

  facet_var <- rlang::ensym(facet_var)

  summary_df <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(!!class_var),
      !is.na(!!category_var),
      !is.na(!!facet_var)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(
      !!facet_var,
      !!class_var,
      !!category_var,
      name = "count"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      !!facet_var,
      !!class_var
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      total_count = sum(count),
      percent = 100 * count / total_count
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  total_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      !!facet_var,
      !!class_var,
      total_count
    )

  list(
    summary_df = summary_df,
    total_df = total_df
  )
}



# ============================================================
# Plot donut plots showing proportions
# ============================================================

plot_donut_percent <- function(
    df,
    category_col = Category,
    count_col = count,
    percent_col = NULL,
    title = "Composition",
    label_acc = 0.1,
    palette = NULL,
    show_count = FALSE
) {

  cat_sym <- rlang::enquo(category_col)
  cnt_sym <- rlang::enquo(count_col)
  pct_sym <- rlang::enquo(percent_col)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Collapse to category level
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (!rlang::quo_is_null(pct_sym)) {

    df_cat <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!cat_sym) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        percent = sum(!!pct_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        percent = dplyr::if_else(
          percent > 1,
          percent / 100,
          percent
        ),
        count = NA_integer_
      )

  } else {

    df_cat <- df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!cat_sym) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        count = sum(!!cnt_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        percent = count / sum(count)
      )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (show_count) {

    df_cat <- df_cat %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        label = paste0(
          scales::percent(
            percent,
            accuracy = label_acc
          ),
          "\n(n=",
          scales::comma(count),
          ")"
        )
      )

  } else {

    df_cat <- df_cat %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        label = scales::percent(
          percent,
          accuracy = label_acc
        )
      )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Donut
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df_cat,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = 2,
      y = percent,
      fill = !!cat_sym
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(
      color = "white",
      width = 0.9
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_polar(
      theta = "y"
    ) +
    ggplot2::xlim(
      0.5,
      2.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = label
      ),
      position = ggplot2::position_stack(
        vjust = 0.5
      ),
      size = 4
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      fill = rlang::as_name(cat_sym)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  if (!is.null(palette)) {

    p <- p +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
        values = palette,
        drop = FALSE
      )
  }

  p
}



# ============================================================
# Stacked bar plot
# Updated: make plot_stacked_bar() aggregate count internally according to the dimensions actually being plotted
# - internally aggregates counts
# - recalculates totals and percentages
# ============================================================

plot_stacked_bar <- function(
    summary_df,
    total_df = NULL,
    class_name,
    category_name,
    fill_values,
    fill_legend_title,
    plot_title = NULL,
    x_label = "Class",
    y_label = NULL,
    facet_name = NULL,
    x_text_angle = 45,
    y_type = c("percent", "count"),
    show_total_labels = TRUE,
    aggregate_counts = TRUE
) {

  y_type <- match.arg(y_type)


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Internally aggregate counts
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (aggregate_counts) {

    grouping_vars <- c(
      class_name,
      category_name
    )

    # If faceting, retain facet as part of grouping
    if (!is.null(facet_name)) {
      grouping_vars <- c(
        facet_name,
        grouping_vars
      )
    }


    summary_df <- summary_df %>%

      dplyr::group_by(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::all_of(
            grouping_vars
          )
        )
      ) %>%

      dplyr::summarise(
        count = sum(
          count,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Recalculate totals
    #
    # Without facet:
    #   total per class
    #
    # With facet:
    #   total per class within each facet
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    total_group_vars <- class_name

    if (!is.null(facet_name)) {
      total_group_vars <- c(
        facet_name,
        class_name
      )
    }


    total_df <- summary_df %>%

      dplyr::group_by(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::all_of(
            total_group_vars
          )
        )
      ) %>%

      dplyr::summarise(
        total_count = sum(
          count,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Recalculate percentages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    summary_df <- summary_df %>%

      dplyr::left_join(
        total_df,
        by = total_group_vars
      ) %>%

      dplyr::mutate(
        percent =
          100 * count / total_count
      )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Select Y variable
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (y_type == "percent") {

    y_var <- "percent"

    if (is.null(y_label)) {
      y_label <- "Proportion (%)"
    }

  } else {

    y_var <- "count"

    if (is.null(y_label)) {
      y_label <- "Count"
    }
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Base plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    summary_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[class_name]],
      y = .data[[y_var]],
      fill = .data[[category_name]]
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_col(
      position = "stack",
      width = 0.9,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = fill_values,
      name = fill_legend_title,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_classic() +

    ggplot2::theme(

      axis.text.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          angle = x_text_angle,
          hjust =
            ifelse(
              x_text_angle == 0,
              0.5,
              1
            )
        ),

      strip.background =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      strip.text =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold"
        )
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Y-axis
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (y_type == "percent") {

    p <- p +

      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = seq(
          0,
          100,
          25
        ),
        expand = c(
          0,
          0
        )
      ) +

      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
        ylim = c(
          0,
          110
        ),
        clip = "off"
      )

  } else {

    p <- p +

      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        expand =
          ggplot2::expansion(
            mult = c(
              0,
              0.12
            )
          )
      )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Total labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (show_total_labels) {

    if (y_type == "percent") {

      p <- p +

        ggplot2::geom_text(
          data = total_df,

          ggplot2::aes(
            x = .data[[class_name]],
            y = 105,
            label =
              scales::comma(
                total_count
              )
          ),

          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          size = 3.5,
          vjust = 0
        )

    } else {

      p <- p +

        ggplot2::geom_text(
          data = total_df,

          ggplot2::aes(
            x = .data[[class_name]],
            y = total_count,
            label =
              scales::comma(
                total_count
              )
          ),

          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          size = 3.5,
          vjust = -0.4
        )
    }
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Faceting
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (!is.null(facet_name)) {

    p <- p +

      ggplot2::facet_wrap(
        stats::as.formula(
          paste(
            "~",
            facet_name
          )
        ),
        ncol = 1
      )
  }


  p
}





```
